oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT PAGE — Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed from edge LB -> services. Auto-pager sent to #incidents and SRE rotation. Root cause suspected: recent LB/Envoy route rollout at ~11:42 UTC. Please ack and triage.

maya: acked. I'm oncall and looking. Grafana shows spike at 11:42 exactly, 5xx rate jumped to ~15% on edge. Traces show many upstream resets.

diego: I can confirm. Saw a config rollout to envoy-route-service v2026-03-15-4 at 11:41:58. Retry_policy was changed to retry on 5xx with internal_retries=3 + no per-try timeouts. That caused retry storms and CBs tripping on the backend pool.

eli: logs from envoy: ```[2026-03-15T11:42:05Z] envoy upstream reset: reason=connection failure, response_code=502, cluster=svc-api-eu, host=10.2.5.12: upstream reset due to connect failure``` lots of these.

sophia: customer impact: alerts indicate 1800 unique affected users, error rate ~12% for EU region, latency tail increased. Internal SLO breached for 5 minute window. Noted major customers on EU region hitting 502/504s.

ryan: traces show circuit_breakers_on svc-api-eu hit max_connections and pending requests — many requests got immediate 503 from envoy. Retry looping amplified load. Looks like breakpoint: `circuit_breakers.max_connections = 100`, changed LB-to-behavior caused many connections to pile up.

maya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable retries on edge route 2) increase circuit_breaker thresholds temporarily 3) rollback route rollout if config patch fails. I'll apply the retry disable patch now.

eli: +1. Prefer disabling retries first to avoid cascading retries to backend.

maya: applying patch...

maya: ```bash
kubectl --context=prod -n infra patch configmap envoy-route-config --type json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/routes/0/retry_policy","value":null}]'
```

ops-bot: rolling change: applying envoy-config patch to 12/15 edge instances (in parallel waves). Watch deployment status.

deploy-bot: rolled config rollback candidate: `envoy-route-config:v2026-03-15-4 -> v2026-03-15-3` initiated by maya via CLI.

diego: also increasing cb thresholds: ```yaml
circuit_breakers:
  thresholds:
    - priority: DEFAULT
      max_connections: 800
      max_pending_requests: 1000
      max_requests: 2000
```

maya: patch applied for retry_policy disabled and cb thresholds updated. Waiting for rolling restart to converge.

ops-bot: config applied to 8/15 instances; 4 still draining; 3 pending due to connection churn.

sophia: monitoring customer-facing metrics: error rate dropping from 15% -> 4% within ~90s of first patch.

ryan: traces show fewer retry chains; backend CPU spikes reducing. Healthy host count for svc-api-eu rising from 4 -> 11.

eli: running quick synthetic check: ```bash
for i in {1..10}; do curl -I -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://api.redwood.example.com/eu/health; done
``` responses: 200,200,200,200,200,200,200,200,200,200

maya: good. Error rate now steady ~0.9% over last 2 minutes. Still watching for 10min window before full close.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty escalation cleared. Incident acknowledged and being mitigated. Please add notes for postmortem.

sophia: notifying account execs for impacted customers and adding rolling status to incident page: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-0315-01

diego: root cause hypothesis: retry-policy change + no per-try timeout combined with conservative cb thresholds on EU backend caused retry amplification -> overload -> upstream resets -> envoy returning 5xx. Secondary factor: rollout concurrency was too high (12/15 at once) so amplification happened cluster-wide quickly.

maya: action items (short): - revert retry-policy change in release branch - add canary gating to route rollouts (limit to 2 instances) - add per-try timeout defaults to retry_policy - add automated health-check gating to prevent cb thrash rollouts

ops-bot: exec note: I pushed `envoy-route-config:v2026-03-15-3` as stable. Current active version: v2026-03-15-3.

diego: agree on followups. I'll own workspace for rollouts + add a pre-deploy smoke test to pipeline.

maya: closing on-call handoff in 10m once metric window stable. Current status: mitigation successful, error rate back to baseline, customer impact reduced. We will schedule a postmortem.

oncall-bot: Incident severity moved to SEV2 -> monitoring. Please file postmortem and link to this thread.

maya: thanks team. tag me for postmortem draft. :thumbsup:
